title: Posturr: An open-source macOS app that watches your posture in real time with your webcam
description:
Your back hurts from coding for 12 hours straight. Someone finally built an app that won't let you slouch.Posturr watches you through your webcam using Apple's Vision AI, and when you start hunching, it blurs your entire screen. Progressively. Until you can't see anything. Sit up straight? Boom, crystal clear instantly.Uses your Mac's camera locally—nothing goes to the cloud, everything stays on your device.

https://github.com/tldev/posturr

#github #opensource
